package.description: A Windows .Net 4.7.2 application which uses VMware vSphere Management SDK 8.0 and CIS REST API to display information about your virtual environments.

en-US.description: A Windows .Net 4.7.2 application which uses VMware vSphere Management SDK 8.0 and CIS REST API to display information about your virtual environments.
en-US.longDescription:
RVTools is a Windows .Net 4.7.2 application which uses VMware vSphere Management SDK 8.0 and CIS REST API to display information about your virtual environments.
Interacting with VirtualCenter 5.x, ESX Server 5.x, VirtualCenter 6.x, ESX Server 6.x, VirtualCenter 7.0, ESX server 7.0, VirtualCenter 8.0, and ESX server 8.0, RVTools is able to list information about VMs, CPU, Memory, Disks, Partitions, Network, CD drives, USB devices, Snapshots, VMware tools, vCenter server, Resource pools, Clusters, ESX hosts, HBAs, Nics, Switches, Ports, Distributed Switches, Distributed Ports, Service consoles, VM Kernels, Datastores, multipath info, license info, file info, and health checks.
The information can be exported to csv and xlsx file(s). With a xlsx merge utility it’s possible to merge multiple vCenter xlsx reports to a single xlsx report.
en-US.name: RVTools

zh-CN.description: 一款基于 Windows .Net 4.7.2 平台的应用程序，通过 VMware vSphere Management SDK 8.0 和 CIS REST API 获取并展示虚拟化环境信息。
zh-CN.longDescription:
RVTools 是一款基于 Windows .Net 4.7.2 平台的应用程序，通过 VMware vSphere Management SDK 8.0 和 CIS REST API 获取并展示虚拟化环境信息。
RVTools 支持与 VirtualCenter 5.x、ESX Server 5.x、VirtualCenter 6.x、ESX Server 6.x、VirtualCenter 7.0、ESX server 7.0、VirtualCenter 8.0 和 ESX server 8.0 交互，能够列出有关 VM、CPU、内存、磁盘、分区、网络、CD 驱动器、USB 设备、快照、VMware 工具、vCenter 服务器、资源池、集群、ESX 主机、HBA、NIC、交换机、端口、分布式交换机、分布式端口、服务控制台、VM 内核、数据存储、多路径信息、许可证信息、文件信息和健康检查的信息。
支持将数据导出为 CSV 或 XLSX 格式文件，并可通过 XLSX 合并工具将多份 vCenter 报告整合为单一文件。
